rules.key: worth over 750 points an Admiral must be included
rules.text: If the fleet is worth over 750 points an Admiral must be included to lead it.
rules.why: The book says 'over 750 points'. The MAND pattern used to know only the form 'points or more', so the required commander went unenforced on 13 lists. Fixed 7.9.2026; the comparison is now recorded too, because 'over 750' and '750 or more' differ exactly at 750 points.

rules.key: one battleship in your fleet for every three cruisers
rules.text: You may include up to one battleship in your fleet for every three cruisers or battlecruisers.

rules.key: one battlecruiser in your fleet for every two cruisers
rules.text: You may include up to one battlecruiser in your fleet for every two cruisers.

rules.key: escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2
rules.text: You may include any number of escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2-6 unless specified (see pg. 13).

rules.key: Admirals get one Fleet Commander re-roll
rules.text: Admirals get one Fleet Commander re-roll included in their points cost. If you want more you'll have to pay for them.
rules.why: Shown as text of the commander section since 9.9.2026 (the sentence filter knows the words re-roll and leadership, P1-8e). The included re-roll is in the resolver's rerolls.included field and on the commander card; the fleet validator does not enforce the number of re-rolls.

rules.key: any mix of Fury interceptors and Starhawk bombers
rules.text: Any ship with launch bays may choose to have them launch any mix of Fury interceptors and Starhawk bombers.
rules.why: an ordnance choice during the game, not fleet composition

rules.key: Some ships may carry Shark assault boats
rules.text: Some ships may carry Shark assault boats at an additional cost.
rules.why: refers to the ships whose profile has the option: Emperor p.53, Oberon p.56, Exorcist p.59

rules.key: Ships with torpedo tubes are armed with ordinary torpedoes
rules.text: Ships with torpedo tubes are armed with ordinary torpedoes.
rules.why: A statement of the default (ordinary torpedoes), not a choice or a restriction; the card's torpedo rule says the same.

notes: The shared Imperial Navy rules are on pages 32-33, not on the list page. Page 32: attack rating 2; Fury 30 cm, Starhawk 20 cm, Shark 30 cm; Power Ram. Page 33: campaign rules and the Space Marine call-for-help table 2D6.
Pages 28-30 and 34 are empty or illustrations.

Updated for Fleets v0.40 on 29.10.2026: v0.40 removed the fleet-wide power ram and prints it as an option of each ship that may take it ('if it is part of an Imperial Navy, Adeptus Mechanicus, Inquisition, or Rogue Trader fleet list').
